svg.title: Building blocks and some of the components that implement them
svg.desc: An application with a Dapr sidecar at the top feeds a horizontal line, and from that line an arrow drops to each of fifteen building blocks. The stable blocks come first: state management, publish and subscribe, bindings, secrets, actors, configuration, workflows, jobs and middleware. The alpha blocks follow on the right: distributed lock, cryptography, conversation, binary store, search and vector. Under each block are the marks of some of the components it can be configured with. State management shows AWS DynamoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, Google Firebase and Redis. Publish and subscribe shows AWS SQS, Azure Service Bus, Redis and RabbitMQ. Bindings shows AWS S3, Azure Storage, Google Cloud Storage and Apache Kafka. Secrets shows AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, Kubernetes secrets and HashiCorp Vault. Actors shows AWS DynamoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, Redis and PostgreSQL. Configuration shows Redis, Azure App Configuration and PostgreSQL. Workflows has no components of its own: it is served by the Dapr runtime. Jobs shows the Dapr mark for the same reason. Middleware shows OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Open Policy Agent and WebAssembly. Distributed lock shows Redis. Cryptography shows Azure Key Vault, Kubernetes secrets, JSON Web Key Sets and local files. Conversation shows Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Mistral and OpenAI. Binary store shows AWS S3, Azure Storage and Google Cloud Storage. Search and vector each show Meilisearch. These are examples, not the full list.
svg.text: Some of the components for each building block API. See the component reference for the full list.
